{{Quote|Very well. I authorize you to activate these agents and bring them here for training. And Tiree, knowing that this would be your 21<sup>st</sup> mission and therefore mark the limit before mandatory retirement of an Intel field agent, we'll keep this one off the books. '''Lens Reekeene''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] born around [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]]. She worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]] until the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] her on false charges in [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]]. While in [[Prison/Legends|prison]], she [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a fellow convict, the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Mikka Reekeene]], who was later released. Mikka bought her release in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], and the Reekeenes became members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Lens later rose to the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]] and founded [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], a group of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] operating in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]], and a part of a series of similar small military units in the Alliance called [[The Irregulars]]. General Reekeene was [[Advisor/Legends|advised]] by both her husband and their close friend [[Santhou Lazith'chika]].

Under General Reekeene, the Roughnecks performed guerrilla raids against the Empire, while doing their best to [[Recruitment Agent|attract]] new members to the Alliance. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Reekeene also led the Roughnecks in "[[Operation Retribution]]," a mission in which her unit ran little risk while damaging several Imperial assets. After the operation, she was captured and taken to an [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|Imperial garrison base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Flankers]]. The Roughnecks then set out to rescue her.

==Biography==
===Origins===
Lens, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CP" /> born in [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]],<ref name="LensAge" /> served as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Company/Legends|company]] performing [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] duties for [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]], a private company.<ref name="CP" /> In [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]],<ref name="LensPrison">The ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' states Lens Reekeene was imprisoned "fifteen years ago." The events of "[[The Long Shot Campaign]]" as described in the ''Star Wars Campaign Pack'' take place "shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the first Death Star" which ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]] establishes to have taken place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Sartran was disbanded by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for [[Treason/Legends|treasonous]] activities, and the mercenaries employed by the company, as well as Lens, were [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] under false charges of conspiracy. While in [[Prison/Legends|prison]], Lens met [[Mikka Reekeene]], a former employee and [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] for Sartran also jailed on false charges, and they [[Marriage/Legends|married]] in [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. She subsequently adopted his surname of Reekeene.<ref name="CP" />

The prison staff made a clerical error, and as a consequence, Mikka Reekeene was released. He gathered enough [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] through a variety of methods to buy Lens's freedom<ref name="CP" /> around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]].<ref name="LensRelease">The ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' states Lens Reekeene was "released three years ago." The events of "[[The Long Shot Campaign]]" as described in the ''Star Wars Campaign Pack'' take place "shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the first Death Star" which ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]] establishes to have taken place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Once free, Lens discovered that most of the mercenaries from her unit had [[Death/Legends|died]] in prison. Desiring revenge against the Empire, Lens joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Her husband was not as interested in [[Politics/Legends|politics]] as she was, but he joined the Alliance too, in order to be with Lens.<ref name="CP" />

Soon, she became an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the Alliance, reaching the [[Military rank/Legends|military rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]], with her husband by her side as her [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. At some point, [[Santhou Lazith'chika]], a secretive [[Alien/Legends|alien]], contacted the Reekeenes, gained their confidence, and became Mikka's main advisor, Lens's second advisor, and a personal friend to both Reekeenes.<ref name="CP" />

===Reekeene's Roughnecks===
{{Quote|Greetings, Green squad. Congratulations on completing your training. As you know, the Rebellion is facing critical supply shortages. Therefore, Rebel High Command has instructed us to direct our efforts towards finding new sources of food and material. Your first mission is to contact the leader of the planet Masterhome, and open negotiations to provide supplies for the Rebellion.|Lens Reekeene briefs Green squad|<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>}}
The Reekeenes and Lazith'chika founded [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], a guerrilla organization of Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], to harass Imperial forces in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. As a part of a group of similar small military units known as [[The Irregulars]] of the Alliance, the Roughnecks tried to attract Imperial attention in order to divert the Empire's resources from other missions, such as the search for the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance main fleet]]. General Reekeene's constant attacks on government offices overwhelmed the [[Unidentified Moff (Reekeene's Roughnecks)|local Moff]], who asked the Empire to send him a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] as a reinforcement.<ref name="CP" /> In addition to these guerrilla operations, the Roughnecks tried to [[Recruitment Agent|recruit]] new members for the Alliance.<ref name="RR" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="LongShot">The events of "[[The Long Shot Campaign]]" as described in the ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'' take place "shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destruction]] of the first Death Star" which ''[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|The Essential Chronology]] establishes to have taken place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> Lazith'chika and General Reekeene briefed the Roughnecks' [[Green squad]] on a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] [[Mission to Abonshee|mission]] to [[Abonshee]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] also known as Masterhome. Reekeene and Lazith'chika used [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] to confer with the [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. Reekeene informed the unit of their goals and motivation: [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] had ordered the Roughnecks to obtain new sources of food and, following that premise, Green squad was to negotiate with the [[Godking]], the leader of the native [[Anointed People]], on behalf of the Alliance. The squad was shuttled to Abonshee on board the ''[[Long Shot]]'', a [[Lantillian ShipWrights/Legends|Lantillian]] [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 Short Hauler]] that had been previously assigned to the Roughnecks; Reekeene commonly used the ''Long Shot'' for this kind of duty. Green squad later succeeded in their mission.<ref name="Godking" />

Also around this [[Time/Legends|time]], the Reekeenes joined Lazith'chika and Rebel [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Am Serro]] aboard their mobile headquarters, the [[Tsukkian water freighter]] ''[[Home]]''. Special operative [[Tay Vanis|Tay "Tiree" Vanis]], an agent of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]], met with them in person. Vanis reported on the results his twentieth [[Operation (disambiguation)|Operation]]&mdash;he had failed to recruit new [[operative]]s and had also reached the [[23er|limit of missions]] before mandatory retirement. Nevertheless, Vanis had vouched for several potential new recruits, and General Reekeene sent him to conscript them.<ref name="RR" />

===Operation Retribution===
{{Quote|We're barely sixty souls aboard this ship, carrying out missions across the Empire.|Lens Reekeene|<ref name="RR" />}}
Reekeene planned "[[Operation Retribution]]," a two-day offensive that spread the Roughnecks' resources thin by simultaneously raiding several Imperial targets. General Reekeene instructed her men to cause maximum damage at minimum risk in the given time, and then retreat. Her intelligence agents had reported on [[Repair Station]] [[M13]], a newly built Imperial repair and [[Fuel/Legends|refueling]] outpost on the planet [[Mycroft]], protected by several [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]]. As a part of Retribution, Reekeene ordered some of the Roughnecks to attack a station in a nearby [[Star system/Legends|star system]], attracting the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] stationed on M13, while another team [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] the undefended station.<ref name="M13">{{WEGCite|story=Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

Once Retribution was over, Reekeene sent an undercover Roughneck team to plant a [[Listening device/Legends|listening device]] under a [[Imperial Communications Center (Iyuta)|communication center]] on [[Iyuta]]. The building's plans had been intentionally leaked by Imperial agents, who intended to track a Rebel team to the Roughneck headquarters. General Reekeene instructed her men to contact [[Chilla]], a local Rebel [[Spy/Legends|spy]], once they reached Iyuta. Unbeknownst to Reekeene, the Empire had killed Chilla and replaced him with an [[Chilla (impersonator)|impersonator]], who was waiting for the Rebels. However, the undercover Rebels discovered the impersonator's sham and foiled the Imperial plot to discover the Roughnecks' base.<ref name="Plant">{{WEGCite|story=The Plant|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

===Later activities===
{{Quote|Priority One Message: Lens Reekeene, leader of Reekeene's Roughnecks, has been captured. Captured vessel damaged; has landed at abandoned base on Flankers. Flankers' sun expected to go nova in 144 hours. Proceed to Flankers immediately and take her into custody. Determine whereabouts of Roughnecks base and identity of all traitors in sector. Good hunting. End Message.|An intercepted message from Imperial probe droid|<ref name="Missing" />}}
Soon after, Reekeene [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] with her [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2 unit]] to a [[Ambush in the Fakir sector|meeting]] with the Alliance [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]] of the Fakir [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Her ship was found by an Imperial [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]], which [[Ambush in the Fakir sector|ambushed]] and attacked her. Reekeene's [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was destroyed during the fight and the X-wing was damaged. The [[Unidentified Imperial scout vessel captain|Imperial Captain]] waited for Reekeene to surrender, but Reekeene instead shot at least three [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] at point-blank range, destroying the Imperial ship's [[Fuel pod/Legends|fuel pod]]. The X-wing was wrecked in the explosion, and Reekeene was captured.<ref name="Missing">{{WEGCite|story=Lens Reekeene Is Missing|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>

The [[Scout/Legends|scout]] took Reekeene to the [[Imperial garrison (Flankers)|nearest Imperial base]], a garrison on the planet [[Flankers]]. The base had previously been abandoned because the system's [[Star/Legends|star]] was going to go [[Nova/Legends|nova]] in a few days, but the Imperial [[Captain/Legends|captain]] was unaware of this. Once there, the Imperial contacted his allies and asked for a pick-up ship for him and his prisoner. Thanks to an intercepted message from an Imperial [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]], the ''Long Shot'' discovered Reekeene's plight and hurried to rescue her. When they reached Flankers, they were identified as Rebels and were opposed by Imperial forces. Green squad successfully [[Rescue of Lens Reekeene|rescued]] Reekeene, escaping before the star went supernova.<ref name="Missing" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|How clean were those six recruits you were bringing in? Could one have been a plant?|Lens Reekeene|<ref name="RR" />}}
A woman with piercing [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and an imposing presence, General Reekeene commonly showed a cold demeanor, although she never did so to her husband, Mikka. Having been a mercenary, Lens Reekeene kept her aggressive and militaristic tendencies even after joining the Rebel Alliance. Her philosophy on warfare included providing her subordinates only with the information they needed, always harassing the enemy, and not keeping her assets in the same place for too long.<ref name="CP" />

Reekeene commonly wore a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] on her left hip and a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] in her right [[Boot/Legends|boot]], and she was adept in the use of both of these weapons. Most members of the Roughnecks wore [[Color/Legends|colored]] armpatches identifying their squad, but General Reekeene, being a commanding officer, wore a white patch. Only she and the other two highest-ranking members of the Roughnecks briefed the squads and answered their questions. As a security measure, once a squad had been briefed for a mission, its members could only speak to the Reekeenes or Lazith'chika.<ref name="CP" />

Through her life, General Reekeene proved her skill as a military commander, first as a mercenary officer and later as a Rebel General and leader of the Roughnecks. She knew how to plan and execute complex offensives, as showed during Operation Retribution. She was also a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], skilled in the art of [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter combat]], and she knew how to survive in hostile environments.<ref name="CP" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The original source that first described Lens Reekeene mentioned she resembled someone who would run a corner store more than a military leader, so it's a bit of a personal decision to illustrate her like someone I knew who ran a corner store many, many years ago.|Pablo Hidalgo|<ref name="pablo" />}}
Lens Reekeene first appeared in "[[The Long Shot Campaign]]," a chapter of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] book ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1988]]. "The Long Shot Campaign" was re-published in [[1994]] in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]'', along with ''[[The Bissillirus Campaign]]''. Lens was first graphically depicted in the [[Star Wars comic books|web comic]] ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'' ([[2006]]) by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], who based her on a personal acquaintance whose identity has not been revealed.<ref name="pablo">{{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}}</ref>

Lens Reekeene's eyes were described as blue in "The Long Shot Campaign," but they appear to be darker in ''Rookies: Rendezvous''.
